name: Say! (Iwanakucha!)
source:
It's early morning on January 1st. Our plucky young protagonist, "Me," has invited his best friend, "Senpai," to make their New Year's visit to the local shrine together. It's sure to be a wonderful outing... and the perfect opportunity to confess his longstanding feelings for her! The atmosphere is perfect, there's no classmates around to make things awkward, and Senpai seems like she'd be pretty receptive! What could POSSIBLY go wrong??

Well... getting tongue-tied, for one thing.

[From [url=https://stellarcanopy.ca/translate/say.html]Stellar Canopy[/url]]
translation:
1月1日清晨，勇敢的年轻主人公“我”，邀请最好的朋友“学姐”，一起去当地神社新年参拜。这一定会是一次美好的出游…也是向她倾诉长久心意的绝佳机会！气氛恰到好处，没有同学在旁让人尴尬，学姐看起来也很愿意接受！究竟能出什么岔子呢？？

嗯…比如，紧张得说不出话。

[摘自[url=https://stellarcanopy.ca/translate/say.html]Stellar Canopy[/url]]
